sentences.en: The town is located on the foreland, offering beautiful sea views.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇坐落在前沿地，可以欣赏到美丽的海景。

sentences.en: Geologists study the rocks found along the forelands of mountain ranges.
sentences.zh: 地质学家研究山脉前缘地带发现的岩石。

sentences.en: The lighthouse was built on a small foreland to guide ships safely into port.
sentences.zh: 灯塔建在一块小岬角上，以便引导船只安全进港。
